description: Keep a heavy layer of protection between you and the external world #boundaries #selflove #choosepeace
transcript: Keep your head on a swivel. The world will make you suffer because of your gifts. I have lived a life where I've had to suffer because of the way I think, because of the way that I look, because of the way that I present myself. The world will make you suffer because of who you are. Know and understand your finesse, know and understand who you are at the core, and keep a heavy layer of protection between you and the external world.
